name_note: GTDB places the genus Gardnerella inside Bifidobacterium, so s__Bifidobacterium leopoldii is the species published and listed by NCBI as Gardnerella leopoldii.

sentences.text: Gardnerella leopoldii was described as a novel species after whole genome sequence analysis of 81 genomes of the genus Gardnerella indicated the existence of 13 genomic species.

Matrix-assisted laser desorption ionization time-of-flight MS analysis of protein signatures identified specific peaks that can be used to differentiate it from Gardnerella vaginalis, Gardnerella piotii and Gardnerella swidsinskii.
In the same comparative proteomic work, immune evasion proteins were more abundant in Gardnerella leopoldii biofilms.
It was among the vaginal species best able to degrade resistant alpha-1,4-glucan in vitro, and vaginal swabs with high degradation activity were associated with bacterial vaginosis.
